market.question: Will Trump agree to Iranian oil sanction relief by May 31?

assessment.reasoning: US-Iran negotiations are active with a framework reportedly emerging (nuclear moratorium for sanctions relief), but Trump publicly threatened bombing if no deal is reached. March waiver for already-loaded Iranian oil exists but the market likely requires a new, definitive deal-level agreement by May 31. With under 4 weeks left and explicit non-definitive language barred per market rules, probability moderate-low.
assessment.key_uncertainty: Whether a definitive announcement (vs continued negotiation) lands by May 31
